newsitem.title: UK: Zeneca bounces back on UBS rating.
newsitem.headline: Zeneca bounces back on UBS rating.

text.p: Shares in Zeneca Group Plc bounced back strongly on Monday as brokerage UBS added the stock to its Europe Focus list, dealers said.

The shares, which were hit hard on Friday on news that the U.S. Food and Drug Administration had issued a warning to the company following an inspection at one of its plants in England, were up 21p to 1826 by 1133 GMT.
Dealers said the shares had been oversold after Friday's sharp decline.
Friday's decline, said one market maker, "was completely overdone."
He said the UBS rating, plus the decline in the sterling today helped the shares recover. --London newsroom +44 171 542 5106
